name: TourTask
author: TourTask

sections.description:
Seamlessly and effortlessly integrate our modern booking system for local tour operators with your WordPress website using TourTask. Your availability checks and bookings will all happen in real-time, as the plugin is connected directly to your TourTask business panel.

TourTask is a connector plugin: the booking and chat interfaces are part of the hosted TourTask application and are loaded from TourTask’s servers, so they always stay in sync with your TourTask account. Using the plugin requires a TourTask account (you enter your Business ID and Business Token from your TourTask business portal). See the External services section below for exactly what is loaded and what data is exchanged.

Features

  • Booking system fully integrated to your website
  • User-friendly and quick booking experience
  • Optimized for SEO
  • Static links for all of your tours and activities
  • Real-time availability checks and bookings
  • Booking and payment page seamlessly integrated to your website for increased trust
  • Collect customer information as configured in your TourTask panel
  • Customize layout and colors for TourTask in your TourTask business portal
  • Optional site-wide chat widget so visitors can reach you from any page

Configuration

  1. Navigate to the TourTask Settings page in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Enter the Business ID and Business Token from the Website Integrations section of your TourTask business portal.
  3. Customize the layout and colors as desired from your TourTask business portal.
  4. Copy the shortcode from the TourTask Shortcode page in your WordPress admin panel, and paste it into your tours/activities page.

External services

This plugin is a connector for the TourTask booking platform (a Software-as-a-Service for tour and activity operators). To provide its functionality it relies on, and transmits data to, the external services listed below. By installing and configuring this plugin you connect your site to the TourTask service; using TourTask is subject to its Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

  • TourTask Booking & Chat application (tourtask-booking.pages.dev) — When a page contains the [tourtask] shortcode, or when the optional chat widget is enabled, the plugin loads the hosted TourTask booking application (/static/js/main.js) and/or chat application (/static/js/chat.js) into the visitor’s browser. This JavaScript is the TourTask application itself — served and versioned by TourTask so it always stays in sync with your TourTask account; the stylesheets that go with it are bundled in the plugin and served locally, not loaded remotely. To render your storefront and process bookings/chat, the application sends your configured Business ID, Business Token, the selected language, and the booking/chat details a visitor enters to the TourTask API. This happens in the visitor’s browser whenever such a page is viewed.

  • TourTask API (api.tourtask.com) — The booking and chat interfaces communicate with the TourTask API to fetch availability, create bookings, take payments, and exchange chat messages, using your Business ID and Business Token.

  • TourTask support requests (api.tourtask.com) — When a site administrator submits the “Contact us” support form on the plugin’s Settings page, the plugin sends — from your WordPress server — the name, email address, and message you enter, together with your site URL and active theme name and version, to the TourTask API so our team can reply by email. This is sent only when you submit that form.

The plugin sends no usage analytics or telemetry and makes no automatic background calls to external servers. It contacts TourTask only to render the booking/chat interfaces described above (in the visitor’s browser) and when an administrator submits the support form.

Terms of Use (including data and privacy practices): https://www.tourtask.com/terms/

Languages

The plugin is fully translation-ready (text domain tourtask). English is the default, and translations into any language can be contributed through the WordPress.org translation platform at https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/wp-plugins/tourtask/.

Support and Documentation

For detailed documentation, visit TourTask Documentation.
sections.installation:
1. Go to the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress and click ‘Add New’.
  2. Search for TourTask.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Alternatively, you can manually upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does TourTask cost anything?

No, it doesn’t cost anything. Our WordPress plugin is 100% free to use. However, the standard TourTask fees apply for using our platform.

Do I need a TourTask account?

Yes. TourTask connects your WordPress site to your TourTask business panel, so you need a TourTask account and your Business ID and Business Token to use it.

Do I need to know programming?

No, our plugin is very easy to use.

Will TourTask work with my WordPress theme?

Probably! And if it doesn’t, please let us know, so that we can adjust our plugin to support your theme too.
sections.changelog:
1.0.15

Release date: Jun 25, 2026
* Added: “Content sits below the header” option (Advanced) for sites with a sticky header above a hero image or other content — the cart bar now scrolls with the page and pins beneath the header when reached, instead of covering the hero.
* Fixed: the “Header element not found” message no longer appears on sites that don’t use a custom header element; the cart bar simply pins to the top of the screen when you scroll to it.

1.0.14

Release date: Jun 23, 2026
* Changed: the booking and chat widget stylesheets are now bundled with the plugin and served locally, instead of being loaded from a remote server.
* Fixed: apostrophes in admin notices and toasts no longer display as character codes.
* Improved: the “force full width” and chat-launcher styles now load only where they are needed, plus assorted WordPress.org compliance and accessibility refinements.
* Added: the plugin now removes its stored settings when you delete it.

1.0.13

Release date: Jun 23, 2026
* Added: choose which bottom corner the site-wide chat launcher starts in (bottom right or bottom left) from the plugin settings. Visitors can still drag it.

1.0.12

Release date: Jun 18, 2026
* Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.0.
* Expanded the External services disclosure to document the optional support-request form.
* Refreshed the translation template; translations are now managed on WordPress.org.
* Housekeeping: removed an unused stylesheet.

1.0.11

Release date: Jun 17, 2026
* Rebranded to “TourTask”; the booking shortcode is now [tourtask].
* Redesigned the Settings and Shortcode admin pages — a cleaner, modern, card-based interface.
* Changed: the connection field is now the numeric “Business ID” (replaces “Business abbreviation”).
* Security: the settings save handler now requires the manage_options capability, sanitizes input, and only writes the plugin’s own options.
* Added: an External services disclosure describing the TourTask services the plugin connects to.
* Improved: WordPress.org compliance — plugin headers, output escaping, input unslashing, direct-access guards, and per-setting sanitization.

1.0.10

Release date: Jun 13, 2026
* Improved: the shortcode helper now collects tour category IDs as individual number fields that grow into a list, instead of a comma-separated text box.

1.0.9

Release date: Jun 13, 2026
* Added: [tourtask] shortcode now supports categories (tour category IDs) and service_area attributes to filter the embedded storefront; both are generatable from the Shortcode helper page.

1.0.8

Release date: Jun 13, 2026
* Added: optional site-wide chat widget (Enable in settings) — a floating chat launcher on every page, separate from the booking shortcode.

1.0.7

Release date: Mar 3, 2025
* Updated logo image

1.0.6

Release date: Oct 14, 2024
* Fixed minor typo in Spanish

1.0.5

Release date: Sep 6, 2024
* Fixed extra space added to site width when forcing full width using Sydney theme

1.0.4

Release date: Sep 1, 2024
* Changed react app root from “root” to “tourtask-booking-root” to avoid conflicts.

1.0.3

Release date: Aug 3, 2024
* Fixed issue when react app files were loaded when not needed.

1.0.2

Release date: Aug 3, 2024
* Is now hosting the files of TourTask Booking (core react app) remotely for improved speed and reliability

1.0.1

Release date: July 10, 2024
* Fixed an issue where settings were not properly saved.

1.0.0

Release date: July 9 2024
* Initial release.
